title: Words to read and colour: Reading joined words with fathah
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 23. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Reading joined words with fathah). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Slide, don't stop
points: Every letter has a fathah: a
Say the letters, then slide them together

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read six joined words with fathah and colour each fathah red. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Six words read: for example خَلَقَ، كَتَبَ، جَعَلَ.

questions.q: Extend: write one joined word with fathah on your whiteboard.

questions.a: A) khalaqa. All three letters have a fathah: kha-la-qa.

questions.q: Think again: Welcome back! When we join letters, do we stop after each one, or slide from one to the next?
questions.a: We slide smoothly: kha-la-qa becomes khalaqa.
